name: Image Tiles Menu
description: Full-screen list menu where hovering an item slides its title and reveals a scattered grid of image tiles, and clicking flips the tiles into a detail view with a split-character title, description and neighbor thumbnails.
contents: Menu items with accent-letter titles and descriptions
Scattered image tile grid per item
Detail view per item with back button and previous and next thumbnails
behavior: Hover shifts the title, fades in the description and staggers in image tiles
Click flips the tiles into a single image with GSAP Flip while characters slide out and in
Back button reverses the transition to the menu
Below the breakpoint descriptions and side thumbnails are hidden and the layout stacks
